entry.author: Whakatāne isite Visitor Information Centre
entry.summary:
Through his work for the Department of Conservation, Rob of Te Whānau-ā-Apanui has hands on experience of our local environment, but also extensive knowledge of Rongoa Māori medicine.

Join him at the festival, where he’ll be demonstrating simple ways you can try Rongoa remedies at home.

DEMO: 2.15pm  - Rob Whitbourne - Rongoa Māori medicinal plants

Visit our website to find out more: https://www.whakatane.com/events/local-wild-food-challenge
